faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the questions on your mind.

delivery.question: How long does the system take to be ready?
delivery.answer: The core booking system in 2-3 weeks, the full system with payment and CRM integration in 4-6 weeks.

pricing.question: How does pricing work?
pricing.answer: We work with a one-time setup fee plus monthly license model. Custom pricing based on business size.

revisions.question: Can I update my services and staff myself?
revisions.answer: Yes. You can easily add services, update prices and set staff time off on your own.

maintenance.question: Does it integrate with my existing website?
maintenance.answer: Yes. We integrate the booking widget into your existing site. A full site redesign is not required.

migration.question: Can I import my existing appointments?
migration.answer: Yes. We migrate your existing appointment data from Excel or other formats to the new system.

mobile.question: Do customers need to use an app?
mobile.answer: No. The web-based booking system works on all devices. We can also develop a mobile app as an optional add-on.
